programme.desc: The scientist and novelist John McAdams is summoned to an emergency meeting of scientists at the Preston Point Institute to discuss a tsunami that has hit the Southern New Jersey Shore. Now the scientists discuss the possibility of a terrorist attack. When John returns home, he finds that someone has planted a file in his computer with classified information to incriminate him since he had written a sci-fi novel about terrorists using tidal waves to destroy the USA. When a second tsunami reaches the Maine, John becomes the prime suspect and is chased by the FBI and the police. Meanwhile he investigates the events with his former colleague and friend Sophie Marleau and when he follows the money, he discloses a huge conspiracy with economical interests of the Camtrell Corporation to construct the Sea Wall defense system to protect the American coast.

programme.title: Killer Wave

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how leopards hunt prey both large and small, offering a new perspective on the way they stalk and ambush everything.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands, slackens at the shoals of the fall line, floods across vast deltas, and reunites with the wild ocean. It's an immersive encounter with stunning wildlife, up-close natural history, and surprising revelations from source to sea. Discover a waterworld populated by hellbender salamanders, prehistoric sturgeon, endangered raptors, and playful manatees. A place we call the American Amazon — a hotspot of biodiversity rivaling anywhere on Earth — is full of stories that have never been told.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: Life and death are close companions in an Eden called Costa Rica. Nestled in the tropics of Central America, Costa Rica calls itself the land of "Pura Vida" - pure life. In a phenomenon known as the "Arribada", the arrival, olive ridley sea turtles migrate annually in massive numbers while troops of capuchin, squirrel, howler monkeys and resplendent quetzals forage in the canopy above. Below roam deadly army ants, poison dart frogs and the strongest insect on earth, the Hercules beetle.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: An Elephant's World
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bullshark
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: After filming one of the most unusual attacks ever seen in the African savannah - four cheetahs being brutally attacked by two male lions - filmmaker Reinhard "Leo" Kuenkel joins forces with world-renowned lion expert Craig Packer to decipher what happened during this incredible take down, and more importantly, why it happened in the first place. They go frame by frame though the footage of the fight to break the details of the attack, and place them in the context of what they know about the way these animals act. Along the way, Kuenkel and Packer make some stunning revelations about the dark relationship between lions and cheetahs, and perhaps finally explain one of the last great African wildlife mysteries.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: The Boteti River is a vital, dry-season pitstop for the tens of thousands of animals that rely on its life-saving water during the annual migration between the Okavango Delta and the Makgadikgadi grasslands. When it unexpectedly stops flowing for 20 years, all life is forced to adapt to the reality of a long and enduring drought.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: At the end of the Ghost River lies an ancient salt pan. Instinct drives thousands of animals from across the Kalahari to converge here, seeking refuge in one of Africa's greatest gambles — where an extraordinary transformation can turn dust and death into life, almost overnight. But this refuge is fickle and exists on unreliable annual rainfall. This year, will Nxai Pan provide a life-giving stopover on Kalahari's greatest migratory route, or will it mean death in the dust for all?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: After filming one of the most unusual attacks ever seen in the African savannah - four cheetahs being brutally attacked by two male lions - filmmaker Reinhard "Leo" Kuenkel joins forces with world-renowned lion expert Craig Packer to decipher what happened during this incredible take down, and more importantly, why it happened in the first place. They go frame by frame though the footage of the fight to break the details of the attack, and place them in the context of what they know about the way these animals act. Along the way, Kuenkel and Packer make some stunning revelations about the dark relationship between lions and cheetahs, and perhaps finally explain one of the last great African wildlife mysteries.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: The Boteti River is a vital, dry-season pitstop for the tens of thousands of animals that rely on its life-saving water during the annual migration between the Okavango Delta and the Makgadikgadi grasslands. When it unexpectedly stops flowing for 20 years, all life is forced to adapt to the reality of a long and enduring drought.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Compilation
programme.desc: Pula, the leopard ruler of the dark heart of the kingdom, faces a tough choice between her true love and her legacy. When Pula gives birth to Motshidi, it is her last chance at a dynasty. Blue Eyes, Motshidi's father, cannot be trusted. He has been known to kill younglings. Pula must protect and train Motshidi to take her rightful place in the kingdom as Pula's health weakens.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Nature's vicious battles for survival come at every scale, from 6 ton Elephants, fighting in a testosterone fuelled blind fury, to slime covered inch and half long amphibian kick boxers, dangling in the jaws of death. This is a no-holds barred look at cold-hearted killers in the wild, revealing ambush experts with piercing canines, slithering assassins with crushing coils, and multi-layered fangs dealing death, in Animal Fight Club.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. Whether an animal is fighting for food, shelter or for survival itself, there are no guarantees. Sometimes even strength of numbers is not enough. In this episode we see a female leopard fight a bigger male for her lunch and her life, discover the complex competition amongst the world's largest Great Apes and see how a Nile Monitor Lizard can turn its tail into a show stopping weapon.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Buffaloes fiercely defend their own against lions. Elephants assert their power, as one bull boldly confronts a vehicle full of people. A cape ground squirrel stares death in the face, and male lions strike at hyenas. Around the next bend, baby animals bust a move, and a tenacious croc targets elephants with relentless 24/7 hunts. Intense, empowered and unfiltered, safari sights always surprise!

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: On this action-packed safari, lions take on black mambas and bold buffalo and compete against their own kind. When these two heavyweight cats come face-to-face, you'll be on the edge of your safari seat.

programme.title: Seen on Safari

Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bullshark
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Monsters of the Wild: Creepy Crawlers
programme.desc: Mother Nature…creator of breathtaking beauty. And it seems there's no end to her evolutionary inspirations…or perhaps? Twisted imagination. From cunning assassins, mysterious mating rituals, and strange parenting to nautical oddballs and toxic terrors. Welcome to the bizarre world of creepy crawlers. Ridiculous...terrifying...but most of all fascinating.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: The Boteti River is a vital, dry-season pitstop for the tens of thousands of animals that rely on its life-saving water during the annual migration between the Okavango Delta and the Makgadikgadi grasslands. When it unexpectedly stops flowing for 20 years, all life is forced to adapt to the reality of a long and enduring drought.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: At the end of the Ghost River lies an ancient salt pan. Instinct drives thousands of animals from across the Kalahari to converge here, seeking refuge in one of Africa's greatest gambles — where an extraordinary transformation can turn dust and death into life, almost overnight. But this refuge is fickle and exists on unreliable annual rainfall. This year, will Nxai Pan provide a life-giving stopover on Kalahari's greatest migratory route, or will it mean death in the dust for all?

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: In this special episode, follow the rare and deadly creatures adapted to survive in China's most extreme environments. In the remote mountain realm, predators and scavengers go to great lengths for a meal. High in the jungle canopy, an Asian hornbill carries its family's future in the tip of its beak. Golden snub-nosed monkeys fight for their right to a family in the mountain forests. And in the ancient grasslands, danger comes in all shapes and sizes.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: Tucci Italijoje
programme.desc: Amerikiečių aktorius Stanley Tucci - vienas įvairiapusiškiausių žmonių Holivude. Iš Italijos kilęs vyras kino filmuose nesunkiai gali persikūnyti į žudiką, aukštosios mados dizainerį, linksmą sutuoktinį, landų žurnalistą, piktą žmogų ar keistuolį. Už filmavimo aikštelės ribų - jis gyvenimu besidžiaugiantis žmogus, su puikiu humoro jausmu ir didžiule meile gardžiam maistui. Tad ne nuostabu, kad jis kviečia žiūrovus atrasti tikrąją Italiją. Italijos regionų išskirtinumą, kuris geriausiai atsiskleidžia ruošiamuose patiekaluose. Stanley mėgaujasi maisto meniškumu vaizdingoje Toskanoje, aplanko Florenciją ir Sieną. Pasineria į kulinarinio kūrybiškumo dvasią Renesanso gimtinėje. Italijos pramoninėje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja novatorišką virtuvę ir futuristinį ūkininkavimą. Italijos vokiškai kalbančioje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja dvigubą kultūrinį tapatumą per šieno sriubą, slidinėjimą Dirndlio dieną, polentą kalnų šlaituose ir žvejybą ledyninėse upėse, ir tyrinėja, kaip istorinė pasienio įtampa formavo vietos virtuvę ir kultūrą. Šiame nelygiame regione Stanley tyrinėja, kaip reljefas formuoja maisto kultūrą. Jis kepa avieną ant grotelių avių ūkyje, mėgaujasi prancūziško stiliaus sekmadienio pietumis ir atskleidžia saldžią konfeti istoriją, atskleisdamas netikėtų kulinarinių malonumų.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Living together for the first time, half-siblings Jack and Lily are pushed outside their comfort zones as they learn to coexist while navigating new family dynamics, friends, and endless hijinks all while helping run the family's pet grooming and boarding business. With guidance from their parents and grandmother, the two will learn about each other's previously separate lives, blended identity, vibrant culture, and the importance of family.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: "Black School Rules" Sora is a high school student who is basically invisible at school. He is friends with Chuya who is an upredictable character that often surprises those around him. Sora and Chuya both have feelings for the same classmate, Kio Machida. Machida girl refuses to come to class, because she doesn't want to dye her naturally brown hair black. Their school has unreasonable school rules, especially about uniforms which including requiring all students to have black hair. Sora and Chuya decide to stand up to change their school's black school rules so that Machida won't have to repeat a year of school from missing too many classes.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Spongicus: Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket! In its place, he has built a Roman coliseum and announces there will be a gladiator show, which means togas, chariots, and ferocious lionfish. And on top of all that, it's free! No one in Bikini Bottom can resist, not even Mr. Krabs! Suction Cup Symphony: The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win. He immediately gets to work on his masterpiece, but when SpongeBob and Patrick keep disrupting Squidward's concentration, it looks like they might ruin his chance at musical stardom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Not Normal: When Squidward points out to SpongeBob that he's not normal, SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal. SpongeBob begins to lose all his spongey-ness, and it's not long before he's completely unrecognizable, even to his best friends. Could this be the end of SpongeBob SquarePants as we know him? Gone: SpongeBob wakes up one morning to find that everyone in Bikini Bottom is gone - even Gary!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donnie's trapped in a mad scientist's lab by the Monster Mutanimals Tokka, Rahzar, Scale Tail, Antrax and Wyrm who are after Wingnut's blood. Meanwhile, Leo, Mikey and Raph try to get pizza but the shop owner is furious: they've made a mess of the place too many times! But the Turtles have never been there before! They're confused until another Tokka wrecks the place in a huge fight before exploding into ooze...and then another Tokka arrives! In the lab, Donnie plans his escape but stumbles upon a video of Rahzar who explains the Monster Mutanimals are doomed unless they find the blood of a stable mutant... and they need Donatello's help! A real-life Rahzar lunges at Donnie, who fights him off until a whole pack of Monster Mutants shows up. The other three Turtles track their Tokka to the lab but are quickly captured. Donnie can only watch as his brothers are shoved into cages... and confronted by the creator of the Monster Mutanimals, the mad scientist Jordan Perry!

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: In a desperate move to deny the Decepticons an Embershard, Twitch creates Spitfire, a new Chaos Terran that looks just like her! When Twitch is selected for an Autobot mission, these twin drones' competitive drives erupt into a storm to prove who is the best of the best.

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: Based on the Monster High franchise, Clawdeen Wolf arrives at Monster High with a dark secret. With the help of her friends Draculaura and Frankie Stein, she is able to embrace her true monster heart and save the school from total destruction.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

La donna, infatti, vuole far credere che l'ingenuo giovanotto sia il marito per farlo eliminare! Sfuggito casualmente ai numerosi agguati, tra esilaranti furti di banane passati alla storia del cinema, il nostro autista forse riuscira' a salvare la pelle...

Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: La terra promessa

programme.title: Quasi amici

programme.title: Potere assoluto

Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Non così vicino
programme.desc: Marc Forster dirige Tom Hanks in una pellicola dolceamara. Dopo la morte della moglie, Otto è un uomo rigido e solo. Ma la sua vita sarà sconvolta dall’arrivo di una nuova vicina.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Jarhead
programme.desc: Swofford, arruolato come suo padre e suo nonno prima di lui, durante l'operazione Desert Storm, nella prima Guerra del Golfo, attraversa i deserti mediorientali con i soldati iracheni sempre potenzialmente all'orizzonte.

programme.title: Sotto attacco
programme.desc: Stephen Dorff sale sul ring in un action-drama dallo sceneggiatore di "American History X". Diventato campione di MMA come reazione a un padre violento, Cash si ritrova a gestire un figlio che vuole seguire le sue orme e la nascita di un bambino affetto da una rara sindrome.

programme.title: The Lost King
programme.desc: Stephen Frears dirige Sally Hawkins e Steve Coogan in un film Sky Original. Ispirata dal Riccardo III shakespeariano, una donna si mette alla ricerca delle perdute spoglie del sovrano.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Il maestro
programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Il piccolo diavolo
programme.desc: Roberto Benigni al fianco di Walter Matthau in una commedia diventata cult. Quando un sacerdote americano esorcizza una donna, salta fuori uno scatenato diavoletto (ITA 1988).

programme.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
programme.desc: Monumentale opera di Martin Scorsese con Leonardo DiCaprio e Robert De Niro. Una misteriosa serie di omicidi tra i nativi americani Osage obbliga il governo a intervenire.

programme.title: Donnie Brasco
programme.desc: Johnny Depp e Al Pacino immensi interpreti di un avvincente gangster-movie. Un agente FBI conquista la fiducia di un anziano mafioso, nascondendo la sua identita' fino all'ultimo.

programme.title: Hamnet - Nel nome del figlio
programme.desc: Dall'omonimo romanzo, Chloé Zhao dirige Jessie Buckley, premiata con l'Oscar, e Paul Mescal nel film che racconta uno degli episodi più tragici nella vita dei coniugi Shakespeare.

programme.title: Il ritorno di Casanova
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Fabrizio Bentivoglio nel film di Gabriele Salvatores, dal romanzo di Arthur Schnitzler. Un maturo regista lotta con le sue nevrosi mentre lavora a un biopic su Casanova.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: Oscar, Golden Globe e Orso d'argento a Berlino per Charlize Theron nel ruolo che l'ha consacrata. La vera storia di Aileen Wuornos, una prostituta diventata una spietata serial killer.

programme.title: Hometown - La strada dei ricordi
programme.desc: Un documentario biografico basato sui ricordi di due artisti famosi. Il regista Roman Polanski e il fotografo Ryszard Horowitz tornano insieme in Polonia dopo 60 anni, e tra le strade di Cracovia ripercorrono l'infanzia e la giovinezza segnate dalla Shoah.

programme.desc: A Rio de Janeiro, l'ex truffatore Dom Torretto e l'ex agente di polizia Brian O' Conner uniscono le proprie forze per affrontare un ricco uomo d'affari che li vuole entrambi morti.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Vin Diesel, 'The Rock', Jason Statham e il compianto Paul Walker nel settimo capitolo della saga. Dominic e compagni devono difendersi da un killer deciso a vendicare il fratello.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Tornano i muscoli e i motori della saga blockbuster in un iperbolico ottavo capitolo che schiera Vin Diesel, Jason Statham, Dwayne Johnson, Kurt Russell e il premio Oscar Charlize Theron. Un'affascinante dark lady, Cipher, usa l'arma del ricatto e della seduzione per convincere Dominique Toretto a tradire i suoi amici e a lavorare per lei. Dom entra cosi' nel mondo del terrorismo internazionale: la prima missione, a Berlino, lo vedra' impossessarsi di un ordigno a spese dell'ex compagno di squadra Hobbes. e' solo il punto di partenza di un giro intorno al mondo ad alto tasso di pericolosita'.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham e Idris Elba nel primo spin-off della saga. Gli agenti Hobbs e Shaw si alleano per fermare un terrorista che minaccia di decimare la razza umana con un virus.

programme.title: 100% Lupo
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione tratta da un libro per ragazzi. Freddy Lupin, discendente di una stirpe di fieri lupi mannari, si trasforma misteriosamente in un tenero barboncino.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Jurassic World - Questo O Quello - Jurassic World.

programme.title: Il giro del mondo in 80 giorni
programme.desc: Colorato adattamento animato del capolavoro di Jules Verne. La scimmietta Passepartout e il ranocchio Phileas partono per un folle viaggio per battere il record di un famoso esploratore.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Animali fantastici: i crimini di Grindelwald
programme.desc: Eddie Redmayne, Johnny Depp e Jude Law nel secondo spin-off della saga di "Harry Potter", scritto da J.K. Rowling. Albus Silente deve fermare il diabolico piano dell'evaso Grindelwald.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Tutti per Uma

Arrestato in una piccola citta', riesce a fuggire mentre viene scortato fino a Washington da alcuni agenti dell'FBI. Frank riesce a nascondersi tra i boschi, dove si trova anche Ray Keene, un ex poliziotto in campeggio con il figlio Chris. Dopo averlo tratto in salvo, Ray vuole consegnarlo alla giustizia ma gli uomini di Cordell sono sulle loro tracce per liberarlo e portare a termine il loro incarico.

programme.desc: Rebecca Hall e Jason Sudeikis fra i paesaggi dei Maine in una commedia sul senso della perdita. Hannah, la giovane vedova dell'acclamato folk singer Hunter Miles, sta scrivendo la biografia del defunto marito nel tentativo di elaborare il lutto che la tormenta. Alla stesura collabora Andrew, uno scrittore e professore universitario che cerchera' di incrinare il guscio di rabbia e solitudine in cui Hannah si e' rinchiusa. Non solo per ultimare il libro, ma soprattutto per aiutarla a rifarsi una vita. Opera prima di Sean Mewshaw, assistente alla regia di Martin Scorsese in "Gangs of New York".

programme.desc: Un'intensa storia romantica con la straordinaria coppia da Oscar, Robert De Niro-Meryl Streep. Lui ingegnere, lei disegnatrice pubblicitaria, si incontrano casualmente in una libreria di New York, alla vigilia di Natale. Si rivedono poi ogni giorno, sul treno per andare a lavoro. Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Dirette in Florida per le agognate vacanze, due amiche di lunga data conoscono sull'aereo il bellissimo Ryan (Matt Barr) e ne sono subito attratte. Quando i passeggeri saranno costretti a un soggiorno forzato a St.Louis a causa di un uragano in arrivo, le due amiche metteranno da parte ogni scrupolo e ogni principio di lealta' pur di sedurre il loro compagno di viaggio in una girandola di imprevisti e brutte figure. programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

Oltre ai guai in cui finiscono ogni volta che affrontano una missione, questi goffi pompieri dovranno vedersela con lo zelante comandante della caserma e con un fastidioso giornalista alla ricerca continua di scoop. programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.
